agreed_facts.text: Sally Rooney's books are no longer being sold in the UK because of her support for Palestine Action.
Palestine Action is a group banned in Britain.
The issue stems from Rooney's plan to direct her royalties or book revenues to Palestine Action.
Rooney is described as a bestselling author.
Her publisher made a statement on the matter.
